title: Electrical and Electronics Repairers, Powerhouse, Substation, and Relay
description: Inspect, test, repair, or maintain electrical equipment in generating stations, substations, and in-service relays.

projection.title: Electrical and electronics repairers, powerhouse, substation, and relay

tasks.text: Inspect and test equipment and circuits to identify malfunctions or defects, using wiring diagrams and testing devices such as ohmmeters, voltmeters, or ammeters.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Electrical testing requires hands-on instrument use

dwas.name: Inspect equipment to locate or identify electrical problems.
Test electrical equipment or systems to ensure proper functioning.

tasks.text: Prepare and maintain records detailing tests, repairs, and maintenance.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Document routine operational activities from inputs

dwas.name: Document operational activities.
Maintain repair or maintenance records.

tasks.text: Consult manuals, schematics, wiring diagrams, and engineering personnel to troubleshoot and solve equipment problems and to determine optimum equipment functioning.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Technical reading for maintenance well handled

dwas.name: Read technical information needed to perform maintenance or repairs.

tasks.text: Analyze test data to diagnose malfunctions, to determine performance characteristics of systems, or to evaluate effects of system modifications.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Performance data analysis; equipment context human

dwas.name: Analyze test or performance data to assess equipment operation.

tasks.text: Open and close switches to isolate defective relays, performing adjustments or repairs.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on wiring repair in physical environment

dwas.name: Control power supply connections.
Repair electrical circuits or wiring.

tasks.text: Notify facility personnel of equipment shutdowns.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Real-time coworker coordination is relational work

dwas.name: Confer with coworkers to coordinate work activities.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Repair, replace, and clean equipment and components such as circuit breakers, brushes, and commutators.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical component-level repair work

dwas.name: Clean equipment, parts, or tools to repair or maintain them in good working order.
Repair electrical components.

tasks.text: Run signal quality and connectivity tests for individual cables, and record results.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Write test result reports from data

dwas.name: Test electrical equipment or systems to ensure proper functioning.
Document test results.

tasks.text: Maintain inventories of spare parts for all equipment, requisitioning parts as necessary.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Ordering via systems automatable; human approves spend

dwas.name: Maintain inventories of materials, equipment, or products.
Order materials, supplies, or equipment.

tasks.text: Construct, test, maintain, and repair substation relay and control systems.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Electrical testing requires hands-on instrument use

dwas.name: Test electrical equipment or systems to ensure proper functioning.
Repair electronic equipment.

tasks.text: Test insulators and bushings of equipment by inducing voltage across insulation, testing current, and calculating insulation loss.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Electrical probing and meter work by hand

dwas.name: Test electrical circuits or components for proper functioning.

tasks.text: Schedule and supervise the construction and testing of special devices and the implementation of unique monitoring or control systems.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — AI coordinates repair schedules; human handles field issues

dwas.name: Schedule repair, installation or maintenance activities.
Supervise employees.

tasks.text: Schedule and supervise splicing or termination of cables in color-code order.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — AI coordinates repair schedules; human handles field issues

dwas.name: Schedule repair, installation or maintenance activities.
Supervise employees.

tasks.text: Test oil in circuit breakers and transformers for dielectric strength, refilling oil periodically.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Fluid testing requires lab equipment handling

dwas.name: Test fluids to identify contamination or other problems.

tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Connecting electrical components is manual work

dwas.name: Connect electrical components or equipment.
